# Offline cache

<p class="cli-lead">Keep working when the server is unreachable.</p>

With `cache: true` in `.clavis.yaml` (`clavis init` sets it),
`clavis run` saves an AES-256-GCM encrypted copy of the values after each
successful fetch. If the server can't be reached, it uses that copy for
up to 24 hours and prints a warning.

The cache key is kept in the OS keychain (or the credential file), and
each cache is tied to one server, organization, project and environment.
Set `cache: false` to turn it off for a project. Delete the cache folder
(or `CLAVIS_CACHE_DIR`) to clear it.
